dict.string: wodAI connects to your heart rate monitor or watch to show your live heart rate during workouts and how hard each one was.
wodAI uses the camera to read a workout off your gym's whiteboard and add it to your day.

wodAI reads your workouts, heart rate, cardio fitness and body measurements to suggest a starting level and fill in your profile. A summary of your last 90 days of training is saved to your wodAI account to plan your workouts.
wodAI saves the workouts you finish, with their heart rate and estimated calories, so they count toward your Activity rings.
